fluidlogistics.ponder.blaze_cooler/conve: Place a Blaze Burner in a cold biome
Once sufficiently cold, a Blaze Burner turns into a Blaze Cooler
fluidlogistics.ponder.blaze_cooler/fueli: Blaze Coolers can provide Cooling to Items processed in a Basin
For this, the Blaze has to be fed with cooling fuel
With a Frost Cake, the Cooler can reach an even stronger level of cooling
The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms
fluidlogistics.ponder.copper_frogport_pl: Copper Frogports can be placed on any face of a block
fluidlogistics.ponder.faucet.text_1: Faucets can fill items with fluids
fluidlogistics.ponder.faucet.text_2: Faucets intelligently choose a fluid based on the item
fluidlogistics.ponder.faucet.text_3: Unlike Smart Faucets, Faucets cannot fill items on belts
fluidlogistics.ponder.faucet.text_4: Faucets can also fill some fluid containers
fluidlogistics.ponder.fluid_inventory_ac: Accessing Fluid Containers using Fluid Inventory Access Ports
Fluid Containers can sometimes be difficult to access
Fluid Inventory Access Ports extend Fluid Containers for easier access
Fluid Inventory Access Ports provide fluid access from any side
Fluid Inventory Access Ports can also be disabled by redstone signals
Note that Fluid Inventory Access Ports cannot be chained
However, one fluid container can connect to multiple Fluid Inventory Access Ports at the same time
fluidlogistics.ponder.fluid_packager_add: Routing Fluid Packages with an Address
Fluid packages are destroyed by Mechanical Saws without dropping any items
Besides filters, Package Frogports and Postboxes can also route fluid packages
Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
When a sign is placed on a Fluid Packager...
Created Fluid Packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
Package Filters route Fluid Packages based on their address
fluidlogistics.ponder.fluid_packager.tex: Attach Fluid Packagers to the Fluid Tanks they should target
Given redstone power, it will package fluid from the tank into a Fluid Package
These can be picked up and transported like any other item
Fluid Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking their contents into the Fluid Tank
Fluid Packagers will not accept Fluid Packages they cannot fully unpack
fluidlogistics.ponder.fluid_repackager.t: Sometimes, requested item and fluid cargo need to arrive in a single Package
In this case, redirect the Packages into a storage block
Place a Re-Packager on the storage block and activate it with a redstone signal
The Unpackager can now split a Package containing both item and fluid cargo into the appropriate containers
Packages that cannot be fully unpacked will be cached in the Unpackager until their contents fit into the corresponding containers
Additionally, the Unpackager can separate different types of cargo
Place an Unpackager on the storage block and activate it with a redstone signal
Fluid Transporters can move fluid from one container to another
Fluid Transporters can use filters to restrict which fluids are allowed through
Fluid Transporters can also be disabled by redstone signals
Fluid Transporters can also connect like this
Note that Fluid Transporters cannot connect sideways like this
fluidlogistics.ponder.mechanical_fluid_g: Mechanical Fluid Guns have to be assigned targets before they are placed
Right-Click depots, belts, or other components while holding the Mechanical Fluid Gun to assign them as Targets
Right-Click a selected target again to remove its Selection
Once placed, the Mechanical Fluid Gun will target the blocks selected previously
Mechanical Fluid Guns use the fluid container below them as their fluid source
They can manage multiple targets within range at the same time
Not every fluid container can be interacted with directly
In this situation, Fluid Hatches can expose these containers as targets
fluidlogistics.ponder.multi_fluid_access: Accessing Fluids with Multi-Fluid Access Ports
Multi-Fluid Containers can sometimes be difficult to access
Multi-Fluid Access Ports extend Fluid Containers for easier access
Multi-Fluid Access Ports can access fluids in up to three directions at once
Filters can also be configured separately for each of the three directions
Multi-Fluid Access Ports can also be disabled by redstone signals
Note that Multi-Fluid Access Ports cannot be chained
However, one fluid container can connect to multiple Multi-Fluid Access Ports at the same time
fluidlogistics.ponder.multi_fluid_tank_s: Multi-Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
Their base can be up to 3 x 3 blocks...
Using a Wrench, the tank windows can be toggled
Storing Multiple Fluids in Multi-Fluid Tanks
Multi-Fluid Tanks can store up to eight fluid types in one structure
Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
A Comparator measures the combined fill level
However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
Basins, Item Drains and Spouts can drain or fill fluid-containing items automatically
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_1: Fluid Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_2: Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_3: The network behind is now pulling fluids...
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_4: ...while the network in front is transferring it outward
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_5: The pump's direction is unaffected by the input rotation
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_flow.text_6: Instead, scroll over the top selector to reverse the direction
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_speed.text_1: Regardless of speed, Fluid Pumps affect pipes connected up to 24 blocks away
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_speed.text_2: Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_speed.text_3: ...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_speed.text_4: Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
fluidlogistics.ponder.pump_speed.text_5: Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
fluidlogistics.ponder.smart_faucet.text_: Smart Faucets can fill items with fluids
Filters can restrict which fluid types are allowed through
Smart Faucets can also fill some fluid containers
Smart Faucets can also fill items on belts
Without a filter, Smart Faucets choose the fluid intelligently based on the item
fluidlogistics.ponder.smart_hopper.heade: Transferring Items and Fluids with Smart Hoppers
fluidlogistics.ponder.smart_hopper.text_: Smart Hoppers pull fluids from above and output them through their spout
Smart Hoppers can also be disabled by redstone signals
Smart Hoppers can also be chained together
Smart Hoppers can transfer items as well as fluids
Smart Hoppers can also use filters to restrict which items and fluids are allowed through
